name: irritable bowel syndrome
description: Irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) is a chronic functional condition of the lower gastrointestinal (GI) tract characterized by abdominal pain or discomfort and disordered bowel habit (diarrhea, constipation, or fluctuation between the two).

warnings.detail: higher rate of severe and serious treatment-related side effects for Adakveo compared with placebo

benefit-risk balance of Adakveo is no longer considered favourable (No new safety concerns were identified. However, there were higher rates of grade ≥3 treatment related adverse events as well as of serious related adverse events for crizanlizumab compared to placebo.)
